landing.meta.title: Accrue · your NIM and dollars, earning
landing.hero.title: Your NIM and dollars, earning.
landing.hero.sub: Stake NIM with a pool we check actually pays you, payout by payout. Put dollars into Aave with one signature and no gas token
landing.hero.proof: Aave v3 on Polygon · {n} Nimiq pools · open source
landing.orbit.aria: An example stake growing one ring per payout, with the {n} listed Nimiq pools on an orbit around it
landing.orbit.legendExpected: expected from the published fee + schedule
landing.orbit.verdictPending: Payout Check: not enough data yet
landing.how.title: Put it to work. Then check it.
landing.how.lede: Dollars and NIM earn in different places. Accrue handles both from inside Nimiq Pay and shows what they earn in your own currency.
landing.how.s1.title: Sign once
landing.how.s1.body: Dollars into Aave v3 on Polygon, from $1. Sign one permit; Accrue's relayer pays the gas, so you need no POL. aUSDT0 lands in your wallet and grows. Withdraw the same way, any time.
landing.how.s1.aria: You sign one permit; the relayer pays gas; USDT0 goes through the router into Aave v3; aUSDT0 returns straight to your wallet.
landing.how.s2.title: Stake
landing.how.s2.body: NIM into one of {n} listed pools. Compare fee, schedule and payout record, then stake in one tap. Rewards restake or pay out on the pool's own schedule.
landing.how.s2.aria: A stake disc with one ring per payout; the next ring is dashed until it lands.
landing.how.s3.title: Check
landing.how.s3.body: Every payout, held to its promise. Accrue reads each pool's rewards and payouts from the Nimiq chain and compares what reached you with what its fee and schedule promised.
landing.how.s3.aria: Expected payouts above, received payouts below, matched one by one; the newest is still pending.
landing.how.s3.note: matched payout by payout · newest pending
landing.check.title: Expected, received, and a plain verdict.
landing.check.lede: The network pays each pool on-chain. The pool pays its stakers off-chain, and nothing forces it to pass rewards on. Accrue does the arithmetic and says what it sees, including when it can't tell.
landing.check.expected.title: Expected
landing.check.expected.body: Your share of the pool's rewards over the last 7 days, minus the fee it publishes, due on the schedule it publishes.
landing.check.expected.formula: your stake ÷ pool stake × pool rewards × (1 − fee)
landing.check.received.title: Received
landing.check.received.body: What actually reached your address from the pool in the same window: restakes credited to you, or direct transfers.
landing.check.received.formula: sum of payouts to you, last 7 days

landing.risks.title: What can go wrong, in plain words.
landing.risks.lede: Every position in the app shows the protocol, that the rate varies, what can go wrong and how long an exit takes. Here is the short version.
landing.risks.r1.title: Smart-contract risk
landing.risks.r1.body: Your dollars sit in Aave v3 on Polygon, reached through Accrue's router. A bug in either could lose funds. Aave v3 is audited and has run on Polygon since 2022; the router is small, immutable and open source.
landing.risks.r2.title: The rate varies
landing.risks.r2.body: Aave's rate follows demand to borrow. It moves every block, up or down, and nothing here promises a rate.
landing.risks.r3.title: Withdrawals can wait
landing.risks.r3.body: If a reserve is fully lent out, withdrawals wait until borrowers repay or new deposits come in.
landing.risks.r4.title: Unstaking takes up to a day
landing.risks.r4.body: Unstaked NIM unlocks 12 to 24 hours later, once the current epoch ends, and earns nothing while it waits.
landing.risks.r5.title: Pools pay off-chain
landing.risks.r5.body: The network pays the pool, not you. The pool decides when and how much to pass on. The Payout Check can flag a pool; it can't make it pay.
landing.trust.title: A router with no owner.
landing.trust.t1.title: Immutable
landing.trust.t1.body: No admin, no upgrade path. The code that ships is the code that runs.
landing.trust.t2.title: No owner
landing.trust.t2.body: Nobody can pause it, change it or move funds through it.
landing.trust.t3.title: No fees
landing.trust.t3.body: Accrue takes nothing from deposits, withdrawals or rewards. Gas for dollar moves is on us.
landing.trust.t4.title: Only to you
landing.trust.t4.body: Funds can only go back to the address that signed. The router holds zero after every call.
landing.trust.notePending: MIT licensed. The router's address and verified source will be listed here once it is deployed.
landing.trust.noteLive: MIT licensed. The router lives at {address} on Polygon.
